references.text: Introduces Noah's three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth
Mentions the three sons of Noah who were born to him
Confirms that Noah together with his sons Shem, Ham, and Japheth entered the ark
Confirms that all people on earth descend from Noah's three sons
Repeats the phrase 'Ham, father of Canaan,' linking Ham to Canaan in the account of Noah's disgrace
Introduces the genealogy of Noah's sons Shem, Ham, and Japheth
Lists the sons of Ham, including Canaan, confirming that Ham is the father of Canaan
9:18 specifies the identity of those mentioned anonymously in 8:18 and completes the description of the event.
